title: Possum's Anti-Trample
description: Simple enabling and disabling of global crop trampling.
body:
# Possum's Anti-Trample
## Features
- Global functionality.
- Enable and disable in-game.
- One simple config setting.
- Operator-only commands.

## Commands

### /antitrample enable
Enable the global anti-trample system.

### /antitrample disable 
Disable the global anti-trample system. 

### /antitrample status
Get the global status of the anti-trample system (enabled/disabled).
